housing: New Orleans rentals are largely shotgun doubles, creole cottages and older houses split into apartments, many over a century old.

climate: Heat and humidity cause mold and termites, so check walls, floors and window frames; test the air conditioning and ask about flooding and hurricane preparation.
fact: Many New Orleans renters live in one side of a shotgun double, a long narrow house with rooms in a row.
